memory_measurement: Peak process memory not measured; enforced container limits recorded per sample

timing_scope.container_seconds: Docker State.FinishedAt minus State.StartedAt, parsed at nanosecond precision. Includes native process startup and normal exit; excludes Docker create and host client/inspection/removal/permission cleanup. Uses daemon wall-clock timestamps, not a monotonic or portal timer.
timing_scope.wall_seconds: Host monotonic timer from output/scratch setup through Docker create/start/inspect/remove, permission cleanup and scratch deletion; complete-table comparison and output deletion are excluded.

method: Alternating AB/BA pairs; fresh containers and outputs; caches not flushed; all samples retained
correctness: Both complete tables matched exactly in all 6 rounds
notes: Generated-data Linux CI comparison, not the hidden portal score. Wall times include this harness's inspect/remove calls and are not identical in scope to the older docker_run.sh wall benchmark.
